description: React component for configuring follow-up prompts with multiple provider options, including UI elements, state management, API interactions, and user notifications.

methods.name: FollowUpPrompts
methods.description: React functional component for managing follow-up prompt configurations, including provider selection, input handling, saving settings, and UI rendering.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates follow-up prompts configuration state for a given key and value.

methods.name: handleSelectedProviderChange
methods.description: Handles change in selected provider from dropdown.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a specific input value for a provider and manages mutually exclusive provider selection.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current follow-up prompts configuration via API call and shows success/error notifications.

methods.name: checkDisabled
methods.description: Determines if the Save button should be disabled based on current configuration state.
